"Oo raggii reer binu Israa'iilna waxay raggii reer Yahuudah ugu jawaabeen, War boqorka toban meelood baannu ku leennahay, oo weliba Daa'uud annagaa idinkaga xaq leh, haddaba maxaad noo quudhsateen oo aad hore noo weyddiin weydeen talo ku saabsan boqorkeenna soo celintiisa? This verse teaches us something really important about God 💝. He loves us SO much! 🌟

Think about it: just like an artist 🎨 carefully paints every detail, God carefully created everything — including YOU! 😊
